description: The donut chart visually represents the composition of the Darija Open Dataset Version 2, breaking down its content into six distinct categories as indicated by the legend: Moroccan Names, Semantic Categories (e.g., Food, Economy), Syntactic Roles (e.g., Verbs, Nouns, Adjectives), Translated Sentences, Extra + Augmented Data, and Pending Translations. The chart displays absolute counts rather than percentages, with the largest segment corresponding to “Translated Sentences” at 45,387 entries, followed by “Pending Translations” at 43,000, and “Extra + Augmented Data” at 30,000. The “Syntactic Roles” category accounts for 23,108 entries, while “Moroccan Names” and “Semantic Categories” are represented by much smaller slices, with the latter appearing as a very thin sliver. The chart uses a muted color palette with distinct shades for each category, and numerical values are displayed directly on the corresponding segments for clarity. The central hole of the donut emphasizes the proportional relationship among the categories, with the largest segments occupying the majority of the visual space, suggesting a primary focus on translated and pending translation content in this version of the dataset.
